name: Cutler's Cookies & Sandwiches (Draper / Salt Lake Area) Hot Roasted Turkey & Swiss on Soft White Bread
brandOrRestaurant: Cutler's Cookies & Sandwiches (Salt Lake / Draper Area, UT)
searchKeywords: roasted turkey sandwich salt lake draper
whyItWorks: Thick-sliced bakery white bread piled with real slow-roasted turkey breast and aged Swiss cheese alongside a cup of chicken noodle soup makes a gentle, home-cooked lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roasted Turkey Breast Sandwich on homemade white bread with Swiss cheese and light mayo (no lettuce or tomato); if grabbing a famous frosted cookie, share half a plain Sugar or Snickerdoodle cookie.
watchOuts: Skip broccoli cheese soup unless taking lactase, and avoid multi-grain seeded breads
